# Copilot Instructions

## Development Instructions
For development instructions, see [ai-instructions.md](./ai-instructions.md).

## Copilot Instructions
Always create a new branch for your work. The branch name should be descriptive of the work being done. For example, if you are adding a new feature, the branch name could be `feature/copilot-<new-feature-name>`. If you are fixing a bug, the branch name could be `bugfix/copilot-<bug-description>`.

When creating a pull request, ensure that the title and description clearly explain the changes made and the reason for those changes. Include any relevant issue numbers in the description.
